method: Read-only inspection of final native browser PNG captures; no additional browser launch

captures.findings: Cloud reads as one connected volume. Charge signs are distinct with dark outlines. The lightning STATIC caption is readable in the row gap, and the temperature, cloud-formation and crossing plates remain separate.
Liquid-drop formation and the dry-layer explanation remain readable. Falling droplets fade above the surface, preserving the no-ground outcome.
Cloud shading is coherent in dark mode. Snow, mountain silhouette, airflow and the windward/leeward labels remain distinct and on the intended ridge sides.
The developing-stage caption, ice-rich formation caption, thermal crossing and hail particles remain clear. The crown and anvil retain the original geometry.
The weakening-stage caption and falling hail remain visible without new label obstruction. The cloud is cohesive and the original lifecycle-driven geometry is preserved.

inheritedLimitations.description: The original SURFACE temperature plate covers the leftmost ground-positive charge glyph. This is also present in the exact frozen baseline; the new lightning plate adds no charge-glyph occlusion.
